cast.name: 娜塔丽娅·亚历山德罗夫娜·扎比亚科 Natalia Aleksandrovna Zabiiako

introduction: Four world-class athletes two American Champions and two Russian Olympic medalists travel to Japan to work with world-renowned figure-skating coach Nina Mozer. The grueling training draws out their inspirational stories about the serious injuries, body shaming, and social prejudices they had to overcome on their journey back to the top. Despite the political climate and being direct competitors, the four form a profound friendship on their way to redemption.四名世界级运动员、两名美国冠军和两名俄罗斯奥运奖牌获得者前往日本，与世界著名的花样滑冰教练 Nina Mozer 合作。艰苦的训练讲述了他们关于重返巅峰之路上必须克服的严重伤害、身体羞辱和社会偏见的鼓舞人心的故事。尽管政治气候和直接竞争对手，但四人在通往救赎的道路上建立了深厚的友谊。
